ana (Design): dropped a quick riff on the playground stream scrubber + token microcopy: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2181234567_v1.png
ana (Design): goals: make streaming scrubs discoverable, keep stop/regenerate low-friction, and tighten token copy (don't show decimals). Added a favorites heart on prompt cards for quick insert. looking for accessibility and engineering feasibility notes.
rene (Product): loving the favorites idea for power users. scrubber needs to avoid accidental scrubs on mobile/touch. For copy: prefer "Tokens used" for final readouts, and "Delta" when showing request-only.
kai (Eng): implementation thoughts: scrubber will be a non-destructive timeline scrub (client-side only) until user chooses "regenerate from here". Stop will call AbortController and send X-Generation-Cancel header. Regenerate will snapshot the message state and re-emit. Favorites: persist per-user via API and cache locally. Touch: add long-press to reveal scrubber drag handle on mobile.
frida (Research): user test excerpt: novices tried to tap the message body to stop the stream. we should surface a larger hit target for Stop on mobile, maybe a sticky inline stop chip. favorites were used in 60% of flows during the test for canned replies. Token phrasing confused some participants; explicit label better.
syl (QA): accessibility notes: scrubber must be keyboard-focusable and draggable with arrow keys. make sure scrubber has aria-valuenow and a clear label like "seek response timeline". token pill contrast currently ~3:1 at 11px; need >=4.5:1. screen reader behavior: currently every chunk triggers an output; change to announce "Response streaming" at start and final content when done. verify reduced-motion removes scrubber animation and streaming pulse.
ana (Design): copy proposal: in-message small label: "Stop" (for compact), menu labels: "Stop generation", "Regenerate from here". token microcopy: "Tokens used: 124 (prompt 20, completion 104)" tooltip on focus. favorites: heart toggles, + keyboard shortcut F when prompt card focused.
rene (Product): agree on copy. Shortcut idea: when conversation focus is active Esc stops, Shift+R to regen (scoped), F to favorite prompt card. need to document conflicts with browser/OS.
kai (Eng): we'll scope shortcuts to the conversation container and respect modifier fallthrough. For scrubber keyboard: Left/Right to scrub 1 token, Shift+Left/Right to jump 10 tokens. On regen-from-here, we'll post a regen_cursor param to backend. Also add a cancel header to ensure server-side cancellation.
frida (Research): prompt library keyboard interactions: focusable cards, Enter to insert, Space to preview, F to favorite. Provide live region feedback on favorite toggle ("Added to favorites").
syl (QA): test matrix: keyboard scrubbing, screenreader announce-on-start + final, contrast checks at 11px, mobile long-press reveal for scrubber, favorite toggle persistence across sessions. Also add flaky network test to ensure abort header ends GPU work on server.
ana (Design): updated mock v2 with higher-contrast token pill, explicit aria labels, and mobile scrubber long-press hint: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2181234567_v2.png
ana (Design): decision: sticky inline Stop for mobile, compact "Stop" on desktop + menu for full labels, scrubber keyboard support + draggable handle, favorites with F shortcut + accessible live region text. will push updated Figma frames.
kai (Eng): i'll prototype scrubber keyboard/draggable + abort header this sprint and add an integration test that asserts backend receives X-Generation-Cancel when stopping. cc @frida for favorite shortcut accessibility spec.
